absent: Numeric encodings for partition commands, partition levels, partition errors and flag bits.
Complete layouts for cpuset state, temporary mask bundles and hierarchy linkage, including field types and alignment.
Definitions, initialization and teardown for global collections such as top membership, subpartition accounting, isolated collections and housekeeping snapshots.
Implementations for referenced helpers that compute parent linkage, validity, effective membership, task mask refresh, sibling propagation, scheduler rebuilds and privilege checks.
Remainder of parent effective handling beyond the truncated portion, including final commit, error storage and notification.
Lock ordering, sleep rules and concurrency guarantees beyond asserted holdings and observed critical sections.
User visible interfaces, error reporting paths and persistence guarantees for partition operations.

findings.text: Partition control separates enabling as ordinary root, enabling as isolated root, disabling, refreshing parent effective membership, and marking invalid. Fragments treat each request as a distinct command that drives later validation and propagation.

Processor exclusivity follows requested partition level, with levels above member implying exclusive and member implying shared. Acquiring exclusivity when absent may fail with a missing exclusivity report, while releasing exclusivity when leaving exclusive level is treated as infallible.

Load balance state follows partition validity and isolation. Valid isolated roots clear balancing, other valid roots set balancing, and remaining sets inherit the parent value. Any flag transition or any involvement of a valid root forces a scheduler domain rebuild.

A populated partition must retain usable processors. An error arises when a proposal would leave a populated parent covered by removed processors, or when a proposal lacks overlap with active processors while the affected partition remains populated.

Reset acts solely on the default hierarchy under callback protection. When configured exclusives are empty it clears effective exclusives and drops processor exclusivity when set. Effective membership becomes the overlap with parent effective membership, falling back to a copy of parent membership when overlap is empty.

Partition data changes require callback protection, with isolated set handling additionally requiring cpuset mutex protection. Sibling and hierarchy propagation require cpuset locking, while descendant and sibling scans use read side critical sections that are released before operations that may sleep and reacquired afterwards with reference handling.

Isolated accounting adds a processor when entering isolated level and ignores entries already present. Leaving isolated level removes a processor solely when it remains present in boot domain housekeeping and in the isolated collection, thereby preserving processors isolated during boot.
Bulk isolated maintenance applies per processor logic across a supplied mask and flags deferred housekeeping work when any entry changed. It expects differing old and new levels and warns otherwise.

Exclusive set addition treats a missing parent as the top set, merges into the global subpartition collection solely for the top parent, refreshes isolated accounting when the incoming level differs from parent level, and subtracts the processors from parent effective membership. Removal performs the converse, returning processors to parent effective membership and restricting to active processors.

Admission of new isolated processors preserves capacity for kernel noise housekeeping. Disabled noise housekeeping allows the change, as does any removal overlapping the noise set. Otherwise the check intersects noise and domain housekeeping, excludes already isolated and inactive processors, and rejects additions that would exhaust the remainder. Allocation failure also rejects.

A non isolated request conflicts when its processors extend beyond boot domain housekeeping while boot housekeeping is enabled. Isolated requests never conflict under this check, nor does any request when boot housekeeping is disabled.

Combined scheduler and housekeeping completion rebuilds domains when forced, then handles deferred housekeeping by snapshotting the isolated collection, releasing inner cpuset and processor protections, applying the housekeeping refresh while holding solely the top mutex, warning on failure, and releasing the top mutex. Without deferred housekeeping it follows a full unlock path.

Sibling arbitration subtracts from a proposal any processors claimed by siblings, accumulating an indication of overlap. A sibling claim is its configured exclusive collection when present, otherwise its effective exclusive collection. Empty proposals return without scanning, and the scan skips the requesting member under read side protection.

Effective exclusives derive from overlapping a user view with parent effective exclusives, then removing sibling claims. Member trial handling overlaps configured exclusives with parent effective exclusives, while remaining trial handling uses the user view, with identical sibling removal in all cases.
Remote status reflects a stored marker, while local partition status reflects current validity combined with absence of the remote marker.

Remote enabling requires administrative privilege and derives a candidate exclusive collection. It rejects candidates lacking active processors, covering top effective membership, overlapping the global subpartition collection, or violating housekeeping limits. Success installs the collection under callback protection, sets the remote marker, clears stored errors, forces a rebuild, and propagates task and sibling updates from the top.

Hierarchical propagation walks descendants, delegating remote members to dedicated remote handling and skipping subtrees whose masks and balance state match and which lack partition level unless forced. Empty proposals for valid partitions route through parent handling, children of non partition parents become invalid with parent related errors, and changed members install new effective membership, refresh exclusives when partitioned or configured, reset when leaving validity, notify, refresh task masks, inherit balance state on the default hierarchy, and force rebuilds for balanced members with configured processors that are partitioned on the default hierarchy.

Sibling propagation recomputes effective membership for siblings of a changed member, skipping the changed member and valid partitions, and applying hierarchical refresh solely to online siblings whose membership would differ, with reference acquisition around work that may sleep.

Remote membership changes separate additions from deletions relative to current effective exclusives. Additions require privilege, must avoid subpartition overlap and exhaustion of top capacity, and must satisfy housekeeping limits for isolated level, otherwise the partition is disabled with a stored error. Successful changes apply additions and deletions under callback protection, install revised effective and optionally configured collections, force rebuilds when membership shifted, and propagate from the top.

Remote disabling clears the remote marker, returns exclusive processors to the parent view, and moves to member level on clean disable or to negated prior level when an error is stored. It refreshes exclusives, resets partition data, forces a rebuild, and propagates task and sibling updates from the top.

Parent effective handling serves local partitions solely and requires cpuset locking. Invalidate returns early when already invalid, otherwise prepares return of overlapping processors and negates valid level. Enable paths recompute exclusives, choose root versus isolated outcome, and reject empty results along with housekeeping or capacity conflicts while marking deletions. Disable prepares return of processors for valid roots and chooses member level. Update with a fresh mask rejects emptiness, folds capacity errors, and derives add and delete portions with separate logic for valid versus invalid members.

Unexpected conditions trigger warnings including unchanged isolated levels, negative partition levels, remote misuse, subset violations between effective exclusives and global subpartition accounting, sibling overlap despite configured exclusives, and housekeeping refresh failures. Offline transitions that empty global accounting receive explicit exemption from subset warnings.

Partition level uses member, root and isolated as valid rungs with negated values denoting invalidated prior level. Enable moves to root or isolated, disable moves to member, update preserves or corrects validity, invalidate negates valid level, and remote enable or disable manages the remote marker alongside the same levels. A stored error records the cause of invalidity.

Observed set state carries partition level, effective and allowed membership, configured and effective exclusive collections, flags for processor exclusivity and load balancing, a remote marker, a stored partition error, and hierarchy linkage for parent access and subsystem reference handling. Temporary mask bundles carry working collections for additions, deletions and fresh proposals during propagation.
Deferred work entry acquires full cpuset protection and delegates to combined scheduler and housekeeping completion.
